```{r}
calc_start_end <- function(df, group = 'habitat', var = 'pressure', val = 'impact') {
  ordered_df <- df %>%
    ### flag negative vars
    mutate(neg = !!sym(val) < 0) %>%
    ### arrange by group (e.g., habitat, region) and by a particular variable (e.g., pressure)
    ### move negative values to the front by ordering by `neg` flag
    arrange(!!sym(group), -neg, !!sym(var))
  
  out_df <- ordered_df %>%
    group_by(!!sym(group)) %>%
    ### deal with negs by flipping to positive then nudging negative after
    ### first, set up temp variable to hold the value of interest; find the total
    ### negative contributions; then flip the values to positive if neg and do 
    ### cumulative sums; then nudge the entire cum sums by the total negative contributions
    mutate(tmp = !!sym(val),
           nudge = sum(tmp[tmp < 0]),
           tmp = ifelse(neg, -tmp, tmp),
           end = cumsum(tmp),
           start = lag(end, default = 0) + nudge,
           end = end + nudge) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-neg, -tmp, -nudge)
  
  return(out_df)
}
```

```{r}

avg_hab_impact_tmp <- read_csv(here::here('impact/int/avg_hab_impact_tmp.csv'))

## make data wide
avg_hab_impact <- avg_hab_impact_tmp %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = scen_time,
    values_from = avg_impact,
    values_fill = list(avg_impact = 0)) %>%
  mutate(ssp245_change = `ssp245_medium-term`-ssp245_current,
         ssp585_change = `ssp585_medium-term`-ssp585_current)

# Step 1: Summarize the data to get total values for each pressure within each habitat
pressure_change_order <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  group_by(pressure) %>%
  summarize(total_value = sum(`ssp245_change`), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(total_value) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure)))


habitat_change_order <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarize(total_value = sum(`ssp245_change`), .groups='drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(total_value)) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat)))


 # Step 2: Get plot data and reorder the 'pressure' factor levels based on the total_value
future_plot_data <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  select(habitat, pressure, impact =`ssp245_medium-term`, color) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure_change_order$pressure))) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat_change_order$habitat))) %>%
  arrange(habitat, pressure) %>%
  calc_start_end(group = 'habitat')

current_plot_data <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  select(habitat, pressure, impact = ssp245_current, color) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure_change_order$pressure))) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat_change_order$habitat))) %>%
  calc_start_end(group = 'habitat')

current_totals <- current_plot_data %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarize(current_tot = sum(impact))

# get the change
# Step 2b: Get plot data and reorder the 'pressure' factor levels based on the total_value
change_plot_data <- avg_hab_impact %>%
  select(habitat, pressure, impact =`ssp245_change`, color) %>%
  mutate(pressure = factor(pressure, levels = unique(pressure_change_order$pressure))) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat_change_order$habitat))) %>%
  calc_start_end(group = 'habitat') %>%
  ### to emphasize negative scores on plot
  # mutate(start = ifelse(start < 0, start*50, start)) %>%
  left_join(current_totals, by = c('habitat')) %>%
  mutate(end = end + current_tot, start = start + current_tot)

```

```{r}
#| eval: false
cum_impact_habitat <- avg_hab_impact_tmp %>%
  group_by(habitat, scen_time) %>%
  summarize(avg_impact = sum(avg_impact, na.rm=TRUE))

# Reshape data to wide format
cum_wide <- cum_impact_habitat %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(habitat),
    names_from = scen_time,
    values_from = avg_impact
  ) 


# Create combined factor and adjust positions
cum_wide <- cum_wide %>%
  mutate(
    habitat = factor(habitat, levels = unique(habitat_change_order$habitat)),
    delta = `ssp245_medium-term` - ssp245_current,
    offset = delta * 0.05,  # Adjust this fraction as needed
    x_start = ssp245_current + sign(delta) * offset,
    x_end = `ssp245_medium-term` - sign(delta) * offset
  )

### simplified - offset was throwing off arrow lengths
cum_change_plot_data <- change_plot_data %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarize(start = min(start), end = max(end))

```

```{r}

# Step 3: Plot the future impacts data

current_plots_bars <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = change_plot_data, position = position_nudge(y = .25),
               aes(x = start, xend = end, y = habitat, color = pressure), linewidth = 3) +
  geom_segment(data = current_plot_data, position = position_nudge(y = -.09),
               aes(x = start, xend = end, y = habitat, color = pressure), linewidth = 1.5) +
  labs(color = NULL) +  # removes the legend title
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(current_plot_data$color, current_plot_data$pressure)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = 'black') +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank()#,
        # axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )
ggsave(here("impact/figs/habitat_impact_current_barplot_cco.png"), plot = current_plots_bars, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(here("impact/figs/habitat_impact_current_barplot_cco.png"))
```
